name: Kishon
line: The Kishon is a winter stream in central Israel where God defeated Sisera's army and where Elijah had the prophets of Baal put to death.

moments.title: Sisera drawn to the Kishon
moments.text: Through Deborah, God promised to draw Sisera, his chariots, and his troops to the River Kishon and give him into Barak's hand. Sisera then gathered his nine hundred iron chariots there.

moments.title: The river sweeps them away
moments.text: In Deborah's song, the stars fought against Sisera and the River Kishon swept his army away.

moments.title: Prophets of Baal at the Kishon
moments.text: After the people declared that the LORD is God, Elijah ordered the prophets of Baal seized. He brought them down to the Kishon Valley and killed them there.
